units.source_text: 八月十八日，砂田记者应邀前来轻井泽，他从小诸乘上了小海线火车。

en.t: On August 18, reporter Sunada came to Karuizawa by invitation, and boarded the Koumi Line train at Komoro.

units.source_text: 一位乘客说：在八岳山麓的高原，半夜里有许多蜈蚣类的昆虫爬到铁轨上纳凉，

en.t: One passenger said that on the plateau at the foot of Mount Yatsugatake, many centipede-like insects crawled onto the tracks in the middle of the night to cool themselves,

units.source_text: 车轮把它们碾死，轮子都被油脂弄滑了。

en.t: and the wheels crushed them, making the wheels slippery with grease.

units.source_text: 当晚在上诹访温泉的鹭之汤旅馆里泊宿，次日清晨去了富士见疗养所。

en.t: That night he stayed at the Saginoyu Inn in Kamisuwa Onsen, and the next morning went to the Fujimi Sanatorium.
